mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (idempotency_key, request_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{key,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT idempotency_key, request_hash, response_status, response_content_type, response_body, created_at, updated_at FROM idempotency_keys WHERE idempotency_key = #{key,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_keys SET response_status = #{status,jdbcType=INTEGER}, response_content_type = #{contentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, response_body = #{body,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE idempotency_key = #{key,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
